commands.name: bookmarks-url
commands.code: async function main(argv, ctx) { const terms = argv.positionals.map((value) => String(value).trim()).filter(Boolean); const shouldDelete = Boolean(argv.options.delete); if (terms.length === 0) { ctx.out.warn('Provide at least one URL substring to search for.'); ctx.out.write('Usage: f bookmarks-url <word...> [--delete]'); return { matched: 0, deleted: 0 }; } const needles = terms.map((term) => term.toLowerCase()); const roots = await ctx.chrome.bookmarks.getTree(); const bookmarks = []; const visit = (node) => { if (!node) { return; } if (node.url) { bookmarks.push(node); } for (const child of node.children || []) { visit(child); } }; for (const root of roots || []) { visit(root); } const matches = bookmarks.filter((bookmark) => { const url = String(bookmark.url || '').toLowerCase(); return needles.some((needle) => url.includes(needle)); }); ctx.out.info('Matched ' + matches.length + ' bookmark(s) for: ' + terms.join(', ')); for (const bookmark of matches) { ctx.out.write((bookmark.title || '(untitled)') + '\n' + bookmark.url); } if (!shouldDelete || matches.length === 0) { return { matched: matches.length, deleted: 0 }; } let deleted = 0; ctx.out.warn('Deleting ' + matches.length + ' matched bookmark(s).'); for (const bookmark of matches) { try { await ctx.chrome.bookmarks.remove(bookmark.id); deleted += 1; } catch (error) { ctx.out.error('Failed to delete ' + (bookmark.title || bookmark.url) + ': ' + (error.message || String(error))); } } ctx.out.info('Deleted ' + deleted + ' bookmark(s).'); return { matched: matches.length, deleted }; }

en-US.title: bookmarks-url
en-US.summary: Find bookmarks whose URLs contain any supplied substring. Preview matches first, then rerun with --delete or -d to remove them.
en-US.examples:
f bookmarks-url github docs
f bookmarks-url github docs --delete
f bmurl github -d

description.en-US: Delete matched bookmarks after listing them.
Find bookmarks by URL substring and optionally delete matches
